---
page-layout: full
body-classes: app-page
---

<iframe
  class="app-frame"
  src="https://jbkunst-censo-ia-app.share.connect.posit.cloud/"
  title="CensoLab"
  loading="eager"
  allow="clipboard-read; clipboard-write"
></iframe>

<script>
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  if (event.origin !== "https://jbkunst-censo-ia-app.share.connect.posit.cloud") return;
  if (event.data?.source !== "censolab-shiny") return;
  if (event.data?.event !== "app_loaded") return;
  if (typeof window.gtag !== "function") return;

  window.gtag("event", "app_loaded");
});
</script>
